text: SUPPLY AGREEMENT between Supplier 00 Ltd. (the Supplier) and Buyer 1000 Holdings plc (the Buyer).1. Scope. The Supplier shall supply the goods described in each purchase order accepted by the Supplier.4. Delivery and Inspection. All deliveries shall conform to the specifications set out in Schedule 1 and shall be inspected within five (5) business days of receipt. The Buyer may reject any delivery that fails to conform to the said specifications.5. Confidentiality. The Supplier shall keep confidential all technical, commercial and financial information disclosed by the Buyer and shall use such information solely for the purposes of this Agreement. This obligation survives termination for a period of five (5) years.9. Termination. Either party may terminate this Agreement for material breach upon thirty (30) days written notice if the breach remains uncured at the expiry of that period. Termination shall not affect any accrued rights or remedies of either party.  Reaffirmation: 5. Confidentiality. The Supplier shall keep confidential all technical, commercial and financial information disclosed by the Buyer and shall use such information solely for the purposes of this Agreement. This obligation survives termination for a period of five (5) years. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to its conflict of law principles. Purchase order reference PO-09000 covers quantities and unit prices agreed in writing.
